FILE.ROLE: 主题订阅树模块：维护 filter 与 session_id 集合映射，支持 MQTT 通配符匹配与订阅者检索

DATA.NAME: mqtt_topic_tree_t
DATA.ROLE: 主题树不透明句柄，封装订阅条目数组及容量管理细节

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: mqtt_topic_tree_t* mqtt_topic_tree_create(void)
INTERFACE.NAME: mqtt_topic_tree_create
INTERFACE.ROLE: 创建空主题树容器

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: void mqtt_topic_tree_destroy(mqtt_topic_tree_t* t)
INTERFACE.NAME: mqtt_topic_tree_destroy
INTERFACE.ROLE: 销毁主题树及所有订阅条目资源

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: void mqtt_topic_tree_subscribe(mqtt_topic_tree_t* t, int session_id, const char* filter)
INTERFACE.NAME: mqtt_topic_tree_subscribe
INTERFACE.ROLE: 为指定 filter 追加会话订阅关系（去重）

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: void mqtt_topic_tree_unsubscribe(mqtt_topic_tree_t* t, int session_id, const char* filter)
INTERFACE.NAME: mqtt_topic_tree_unsubscribe
INTERFACE.ROLE: 删除指定 filter 上的会话订阅关系

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: void mqtt_topic_tree_remove_session(mqtt_topic_tree_t* t, int session_id)
INTERFACE.NAME: mqtt_topic_tree_remove_session
INTERFACE.ROLE: 从所有 filter 中移除指定会话

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: bool mqtt_topic_tree_match_subscribers(const mqtt_topic_tree_t* t, const char* topic, int** out_sids, size_t* out_count)
INTERFACE.NAME: mqtt_topic_tree_match_subscribers
INTERFACE.ROLE: 按 topic 匹配所有订阅者并输出去重后的会话列表

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: bool mqtt_topic_match(const char* filter, const char* topic)
INTERFACE.NAME: mqtt_topic_match
INTERFACE.ROLE: 按 MQTT +/# 规则判断 filter 与 topic 是否匹配

DATA.NAME: struct filter_entry
DATA.ROLE: 单个订阅过滤器条目，保存 filter 字符串及会话 ID 动态数组

DATA.NAME: struct mqtt_topic_tree
DATA.ROLE: 主题树私有实现，保存 filter_entry 动态数组及容量信息

DATA.NAME: filter_entry_t
DATA.ROLE: struct filter_entry 的 typedef 别名，表示一个 topic filter 到 session_id 集合的订阅条目

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: mqtt_topic_tree_t* mqtt_topic_tree_create(void)
INTERFACE.NAME: mqtt_topic_tree_create
INTERFACE.ROLE: 分配并返回零初始化主题树对象

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: void mqtt_topic_tree_destroy(mqtt_topic_tree_t* t)
INTERFACE.NAME: mqtt_topic_tree_destroy
INTERFACE.ROLE: 释放所有 filter 条目及其会话数组后销毁主题树

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: void mqtt_topic_tree_subscribe(mqtt_topic_tree_t* t, int session_id, const char* filter)
INTERFACE.NAME: mqtt_topic_tree_subscribe
INTERFACE.ROLE: 查找或创建 filter 条目后追加 session_id（保证不重复）

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: void mqtt_topic_tree_unsubscribe(mqtt_topic_tree_t* t, int session_id, const char* filter)
INTERFACE.NAME: mqtt_topic_tree_unsubscribe
INTERFACE.ROLE: 从指定 filter 删除 session_id；空条目自动删除

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: void mqtt_topic_tree_remove_session(mqtt_topic_tree_t* t, int session_id)
INTERFACE.NAME: mqtt_topic_tree_remove_session
INTERFACE.ROLE: 遍历所有条目移除 session_id，并清理空条目

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: bool mqtt_topic_tree_match_subscribers(const mqtt_topic_tree_t* t, const char* topic, int** out_sids, size_t* out_count)
INTERFACE.NAME: mqtt_topic_tree_match_subscribers
INTERFACE.ROLE: 遍历匹配 filter，聚合并去重输出订阅者 session_id 列表

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: bool mqtt_topic_match(const char* filter, const char* topic)
INTERFACE.NAME: mqtt_topic_match
INTERFACE.ROLE: 逐层比较过滤器与主题，支持 + 单层与 # 多层通配符匹配

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static void ensure_entry_cap(mqtt_topic_tree_t* t, size_t need)
INTERFACE.NAME: ensure_entry_cap
INTERFACE.ROLE: 扩容主题树条目数组以容纳更多 filter

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static void ensure_sid_cap(filter_entry_t* e, size_t need)
INTERFACE.NAME: ensure_sid_cap
INTERFACE.ROLE: 扩容单条 filter 的会话 ID 数组

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static ssize_t find_entry(const mqtt_topic_tree_t* t, const char* filter)
INTERFACE.NAME: find_entry
INTERFACE.ROLE: 按过滤器字符串查找条目索引

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static bool entry_has_sid(const filter_entry_t* e, int sid)
INTERFACE.NAME: entry_has_sid
INTERFACE.ROLE: 判断条目是否已包含指定 session_id

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static void entry_remove_sid(filter_entry_t* e, int sid)
INTERFACE.NAME: entry_remove_sid
INTERFACE.ROLE: 从条目中删除指定 session_id（末尾覆盖）

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static void delete_entry(mqtt_topic_tree_t* t, size_t idx)
INTERFACE.NAME: delete_entry
INTERFACE.ROLE: 删除指定条目并释放其资源（末尾覆盖收缩）

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static bool next_level(const char* s, size_t s_len, size_t* io_pos, const char** out_start, size_t* out_len, bool* out_done)
INTERFACE.NAME: next_level
INTERFACE.ROLE: 按 / 分隔提取主题层级分段并推进读取位置
